Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.gwc

Class GwcSeedRequest

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.gwc.GwcSeedRequest
public class GwcSeedRequest extends Object
Request DTO for POST /gwc/rest/seed/{layer}.xml (GWC seed/truncate). Must be serialized as XML — JSON causes a Jettison-related error (see GwcSeedManager).

      public GwcSeedRequest()

    • GwcSeedRequest

      public GwcSeedRequest(String name, int srs, int zoomStart, int zoomStop, String format, GwcSeedType type)
      Constructs a GwcSeedRequest with all required fields.
      Parameters:
      name - the layer name
      srs - the EPSG code (e.g. 4326)
      zoomStart - the starting zoom level
      zoomStop - the stopping zoom level
      format - the MIME format (e.g. "image/png")
      type - the seed operation type
